order: show the answering model's name at the very bottom, but only while the agent is working
rationale: The only case that exercises the when-condition arm of the bind validator (validate.go: 'unsigned bind %q in when condition of node type %q'), which reports through the same scene.Error type as a node bind but from a different walk and so can regress independently. That validator coverage is the reason it stays, because measured against a real model (deepseek-v4.1-flash, two live runs 2026-09-22) it converged in one turn both times: the model spelled the boolean agent.working directly and did not take the predicted agent.busy miss. EVAL.md is explicit that a case converging in one turn every time measures the first shot -- a vanity metric -- and stays only if its refusal path is still worth pinning for the validator's sake; this one's is, since the attempt reproduces the when-condition refusal against the real validator and holds its wording and address. must_bind names agent.working as well as model.name because CollectBinds counts a when condition's first field, so a converged document that dropped the condition -- showing the name always -- fails must_bind rather than scoring a false pass by ignoring the 'only while' half of the order. The predicted miss is left recorded in the attempt (agent.busy) because it is the refusal a model that did guess from intuition would receive, and pinning it is what keeps the diagnostic honest even though this model did not need the repair turn.

attempts.note: right node, right bind, but the when-condition guesses agent.busy; a when is validated against the same signed set as a bind, and BINDS.md signs the boolean as agent.working
